verdict.rationale: The only free-access evidence is that Perplexity Search can be tried in an interactive Playground with no API key required. That is a free, product-native way to prototype search behavior, but it is not programmatic API access. The usage-tier docs describe advancing tiers through paid credit spend and never mention a free tier or starter credits. missing for 10: documented free API tier or free starter credits, free programmatic API calls (not just the Playground), Sonar/Agent API free access, independent corroboration.
